title: Degraded recommendations
description: PagerDuty alert: error budget burn on recommendation-service; 44.7% of requests failing at peak and some requests timing out.
root_cause_detail: An error path introduced in recommendation-service v2.27.0 did not return connections to the pool; the pool (max 15) saturated gradually and requests queued until the acquisition timeout.
expected_symptoms: connection acquisition timeouts and database errors in recommendation-service logs
recommendation-service p95 latency rises from ~83ms to ~27.0s
recommendation-service memory stays near baseline; CPU at most moderately elevated
utilization climbs gradually after deployment of recommendation-service v2.27.0
resolution: Rolled back recommendation-service to v2.26.7, fixed the missing connection release and enabled pool leak detection.
